what_this_is: How the dossier beside it was shaped, so the reader knows what it is looking at and what it is not. It describes the SHAPING, never the file: every sentence here is the same on every file in every corpus, and nothing in it is evidence.
closed_world: The dossier is the whole of what was sent. There is no document behind it, no page, no filename, no surrounding sentence, and no situation beyond the ones listed. A situation can only be an identifier present in allowed_vocabulary, and a citation can only be anchored in a value present in released_evidence. A folder path may be among the released values.

selection.unit: one file version and the situations of the one kind of material a first judge named for it
selection.what_is_offered: observations the local extractors already produced for that version, each addressed by an observation_key and bounded by a span -- the same released items the first judge was shown, unchanged; the kind that judge named; and every situation the library carries under that kind, each with the library's own name for it and the library's own line saying what it is a record of and what it is not
selection.what_is_never_offered: the whole tree, complete extracted text, whole documents, filenames, OCR output of protected material, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, the person's own typed words, and raw sensitive values
selection.ordering: situations in the library's own order, which carries no meaning for the answer; evidence in the document's own order, bounded
selection.bounded: the count and the length are both capped before the request is built; what did not fit was not sent and is not described

reduction_ladder: none: the dossier fits and is sent unreduced
summarized_facts: facts stand in for their evidence
preserved_anchors: only the anchoring evidence is kept
split: the subject is sent as several dossiers, each judged on its own
reduction_rung_in_force: the dossier's own reduction_rung key says which rung this one was built at
redaction: identifiers the local policy recognises are transformed before the value is written into the dossier. A redacted value is the value that was sent, and it is the only text a citation can quote.
what_is_done_with_the_answer: the situation is checked against allowed_vocabulary and every citation is checked against the released value it names; a situation named with no citation is an unknown and resolves nothing. A named situation becomes the file's situation, which decides which fields the file is asked and which folders it may be offered; nothing is filed by this answer. Whether the file may reach a cloud model was decided by the gate before the first judge was asked, and this call reaches the same destination that judge did, over the same released items.
declining: a situation of none is recorded as a correct abstention and the question goes to the person, in words, with the files it is about. It is not a failure and it is not counted as one.
